name: TOSS Charitable Trust
motto: We believe. We change. We transform India.
intro: I founded TOSS in Tiruchirappalli in 2009 as a youth initiative. Seventeen years later it is a registered charitable trust with more than 150 student and young-professional volunteers in Trichy, Chennai and Tuticorin, and its work has become the setting of much of my teaching and research.

campaigns.name: TOSS Talent Fest
campaigns.text: A district-level sports and cultural meet for differently-abled and special children, held every year since 2014. The 12th edition ran on 24 and 25 October 2025.

campaigns.name: Limitless
campaigns.text: Learning support for hearing-impaired students and aspirants.

campaigns.name: Operation Oxygen
campaigns.text: Tree-planting drives in parks and public spaces, run by the trust's Green Wing.

campaigns.name: Clean Cauvery
campaigns.text: Riverbank clean-ups and water awareness along the Cauvery around Trichy.

campaigns.name: Eyes Bucket Challenge
campaigns.text: A public campaign that encourages people to pledge their eyes for donation.

campaigns.name: Social Thinking Carnival
campaigns.text: Campus events with NSS units that get students thinking about civic duty.

campaigns.name: One Rupee One Nation
campaigns.text: A small-giving habit: one rupee a day, saved and spent on a shared cause.

campaigns.name: Street and school libraries
campaigns.text: Street libraries in neighbourhoods and renovated libraries in government schools.

milestones.text: TOSS starts on 19 March as a youth initiative in Tiruchirappalli.
Youth Fest 2013 at Bishop Heber College puts differently-abled young performers on stage. The Hindu covers it.
The first TOSS Talent Fest, with more than 350 children from about 15 special schools, and a door-to-door eye donation campaign.
I am president of TOSS when The Hindu reports on its sports and cultural meet for special students.
TOSS becomes a registered charitable trust and plants a Miyawaki forest of about 320 native saplings at Golden Rock.
Fifteen years of service. Our paper on the trust's street and school libraries goes to the G20 Library Summit.
The 12th Talent Fest brings more than 700 participants to St. John's Vestry School.

college: At St. Joseph's College I have brought the Department of Business Administration together with NGOs for tree-planting drives in government parks and for student volunteering at district sports and cultural meets for differently-abled children. These initiatives earned the Department a special appreciation from the Tiruchirappalli District Collectorate.
